```{.quiz-yaml}

  Commit to a corner
questions:
  - id: catan_settlement
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Which corner did you pick, and what made it look good? Name it by the
      numbers it touches. Do you think all the dice totals are equally likely?
      What would you need to know to compare two corners?
    answer: >
      There is no calculation to get right yet. Record your choice and your
      reasoning so you can return to them after working through the dice example.
    explanation: >
      We are deliberately not settling this yet. Hold on to your choice: once we
      have counted the ways two dice can land, we will be able to work out
      the probability that any corner on this board pays out, and you can see
      how your instinct did.
```
